title: Understanding Allergies and Sensitizations in Healthy and Allergic Individuals
summary: The purpose of this study is to strengthen our ability to accurately diagnose allergies and understand cellular, humoral, genetic components and physiological changes in allergic disease
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any individual with possible allergy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with special risks attendant to venipuncture will be excluded

sites.f: Sean N. Parker Center for Allergy and Asthma Research, Stanford University
